objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other document types, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit number per document type assigned at creation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: User-defined title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier that increments when content or relevant attributes change.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration for validity review, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language version of the document content.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status mirroring the release process statuses of the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document added to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend document validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, triggered when a document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created in a designated folder.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign collective read or change authorizations and distribution membership.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document who are notified upon release, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: Distribution by E-mail or Distribution for Acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process that routes tasks through defined steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A configurable classification category for documents that determines naming abbreviation, templates, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code used in document naming convention.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for extended validity checks.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: Default retention period after invalidation.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity such as a department or location to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a user that they have taken note of a released document, tracked and documented in the system.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created when content, attributes, or attachments are changed.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: A non-release-controlled supplementary document is added to a main document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is directly deleted from a document due to its non-critical nature.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, and the creator is notified by email.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirm the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is invalidated and archived; all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is restored to active status with a new version, retaining previous metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email notification or acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms they have taken note of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated version of a document is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email to inform users about workflow tasks, releases, validity extensions, or other document events.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, documents are physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment is linked to and released with a main Document.
Additional Information is supplementary content added to a Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific Document.
A Request For Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity must be checked.
A Request For Override is created for a specific Document to initiate its invalidation.
A Request For Reactivation references the archived Document to be reactivated.
A Document can be created based on a Document Template defined for its type.
Each Document is classified under a specific Document Type.
A Document can be linked to a Process for process-specific filing.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Document can reference other Documents via the References attribute.
One or more Document Templates can be defined for each Document Type.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to control notification and acknowledgement.
A Distribution List contains assigned User Groups.
A Distribution List contains assigned individual Users (persons).
A User is assigned to one or more User Groups.
Additional subgroups can be assigned to User Groups (e.g. location-specific subgroups to reader groups).
